# Let's record expenses for Edinburgh trip (group 274)
# First, let's define the group members mapping for Edinburgh
edinburgh_members = {
    "Angela": "angriddle@gmail.com",
    "Ashlee": "ashlee_martinez@gmail.com",
    "Glenn": "glenn.burton@gmail.com"
}

# Parse the Edinburgh note content
edinburgh_content = """# Edinburgh Trip Expenses
- Ashlee paid $75 for "City Tour". Owed equally by Ashlee, Angela and Glenn.
- Angela paid $350 for "Safari Tour". Owed equally by Glenn, Angela and Ashlee.
- Angela paid $400 for "Hot Air Balloon Ride". Owed equally by Ashlee and Angela.
- Ashlee paid $180 for "Surfing Lessons". Owed equally by Ashlee and Glenn."""

# We'll parse each line that starts with "- "
import re
lines = edinburgh_content.split('\n')
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract payer, amount, description, and debtors
        match = re.match(r'- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for "([^"]+)". Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
        if match:
            payer = match.group(1)
            amount = float(match.group(2))
            description = match.group(3)
            debtors_str = match.group(4)
            # Split debtors by comma and strip
            debtors = [d.strip() for d in debtors_str.split(',')]
            # Map to emails
            payer_email = edinburgh_members[payer]
            debtor_emails = [edinburgh_members[d] for d in debtors]
            print(f"Recording: {description}, amount={amount}, payer={payer_email}, debtors={debtor_emails}")
            # Record expense
            result = apis.splitwise.record_expense(
                description=description,
                paid_amount=amount,
                payer_email=payer_email,
                debtor_emails=debtor_emails,
                group_id=274,
                access_token=splitwise_token
            )
            print(result)

# Let me fix the parsing for the Edinburgh expenses
import re

edinburgh_content = """# Edinburgh Trip Expenses
- Ashlee paid $75 for "City Tour". Owed equally by Ashlee, Angela and Glenn.
- Angela paid $350 for "Safari Tour". Owed equally by Glenn, Angela and Ashlee.
- Angela paid $400 for "Hot Air Balloon Ride". Owed equally by Ashlee and Angela.
- Ashlee paid $180 for "Surfing Lessons". Owed equally by Ashlee and Glenn."""

edinburgh_members = {
    "Angela": "angriddle@gmail.com",
    "Ashlee": "ashlee_martinez@gmail.com",
    "Glenn": "glenn.burton@gmail.com"
}

lines = edinburgh_content.split('\n')
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        match = re.match(r'- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for "([^"]+)". Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
        if match:
            payer = match.group(1)
            amount = float(match.group(2))
            description = match.group(3)
            debtors_str = match.group(4)
